summary: Dense colonies of microscopic cells drift in the turbid shallows (F20). Their red-brown accessory pigments harvest the yellow-green and red light window that suspended volcanic sediment scatters (D23, D24). As a foundational producer, it converts dissolved minerals and sunlight into rapid biomass that fuels filter feeders and detritivores across the coastal food web (D25).

links: Turbid shallows absorb blue-violet light (F20, D24)
Green-only photosystems cannot harvest enough photons
Selection favors red-brown accessory pigments to capture the yellow-green/red window (D23, D24)
Pigmented cells cluster in sticky mucilage to retain position in low-visibility water
chains.play: Observe the water tint to locate nutrient-rich patches; use 'Scoop' to gather a mucilage clump for a +5 nutrient gift to aquatic omnivores.
chains.weakness: Bloom collapse if clear water returns, stripping the red-brown pigments' advantage.

plausibility.summary: Planktonic microalgae with red-brown accessory pigments in a sediment-narrowed spectral window match D23–D24 and F20 and underpin shallow filter-feeder chains (D25). Mucilaginous colonies and tidal drift are coherent with F6 shelf dynamics.

analogues.organism: Coastal diatoms and dinoflagellates in turbid shelves
analogues.mechanism: Accessory pigments (fucoxanthin, peridinin) harvest green–red light when blue is scattered or absorbed by particles (Siegel et al., ocean-color literature, from memory, unverified). N₂-fixing symbionts parallel Richelia–diatom associations.

chains.trait: Rapid tidal drift & symbiotic nitrogen fixation
links: Volcanic island leaches soluble phosphates but fixes atmospheric nitrogen via endosymbionts (F24)
High metabolic turnover matches filter-feeder consumption rates (D25)
Mucilage releases slowly as water flows through tidal channels (F6)
Blooms drift shoreward, delivering protein to benthic grazers
chains.play: Place a clump downcurrent to attract corona and sifón; use 'Attract' to pull them into range for easy observation or befriending.
chains.weakness: Non-adapted herbivores suffer gut irritation from concentrated symbiont alkaloids.
observe: Currents pull red ribbons toward shore
